primary_skills: Regular expressions (regex) for locale-specific date parsing
profile.summary: socketpair demonstrates mid-level expertise in JavaScript, specializing in legacy date/time libraries like Moment.js. Their contributions focus on precise regex-based parsing and locale-specific formatting, particularly for Russian language rules. While their skills are highly relevant for maintaining and extending legacy JavaScript utilities, they lack exposure to modern JavaScript frameworks, ES6+ features, TypeScript, or contemporary development practices. Their strength lies in debugging and refining complex regex patterns and internationalization logic, making them well-suited for projects requiring deep knowledge of legacy JavaScript ecosystems and date/time handling. To transition to more modern roles, they would need to upskill in ES6+ features, TypeScript, and current frontend/backend frameworks.
